redfin.remarks: Beautifully Remodeled 2 Bedroom 2.5 Bathroom Van Nuys Condominium! Ready for Move In! Great Location - Beautifully remodeled spacious 2 level Van Nuys condominium. Large living room with open dining area with recess lighting, fireplace, and access to a private balcony with storage closet. The kitchen is upgraded with new appliances and granite counter tops . There is lots of cabinet and counter space. There is a guest bathroom with new back splash and vanity. In addition, the there is a closet that extends under the stairs for lots of storage space . Upstairs you will find two master suites , each with own private baths, laundry area for full size side by side washer and dryer, and additional storage. There is another private balcony with additional storage off one the master suites. The unit has central air conditioning and heating. There is wood flooring throughout. Small complex, great location, 2 car shared garage with tandem parking and a separate private storage closet. The complex is small and close to everything.
